sample: 40 of 240 strings, batch index 6*i for i=0..39 (every 6th string), translated independently in rev023/mine.json (rev023/mine.py) before opening out/023.json
notes: Index 24 (pla-pure FAQ answer, h cccd520ad224): the Arabic wrote «applications» as «التطبيقات», which reads as software apps (glossary: app → تطبيق) where the glossary gives application → «الاستخدام». Fixed in place: «ينبغي للتطبيقات التي تتطلب…» → «ينبغي للاستخدامات التي تتطلب…». Nothing else in the row changed; Sorani was already correct («بەکارهێنانانەی»).

The other 39 sampled strings agree in meaning: every number, unit, footnote marker (62.5%1, 30%2), percentage (15%, 50% RH, 72 hours), code (MH001, H2C, LHS, TPU 85A/90A/95A HF, LIDAR, FDM, (EU) No 10/2011) and limitation («currently apply only to», «cannot be peeled off», «will not work as expected») is kept; glossary terms match (رأس الصهر/سەری تواندنەوە, حشوة داخلية/پڕکەرەوەی ناوەوە, تخييط/دەزووبەستن, مبدّد حراري/بڵاوکەرەوەی گەرمی, صفيحة PEI محبّبة/پلێتی دانەداری PEI, هدر الطرد/بەفیڕۆچوونی فیلامێنتی دەرکراو). Names stay Latin (PLA Pure, PLA Basic, Bambu Reusable Spool, Glue Stick, TPU High-Flow Kit, Vortek, Bambu High Flow Nozzle, Black/White). No Sorani copies the Arabic.

Not counted as disagreements (choice, not meaning): indices 144 and 162 (table cells «High Flow Tungsten Carbide Nozzle Nozzle (0.8mm)», «Induction Hardened Steel Nozzle (0.4mm)») — I kept them English as variant labels, the first translator translated them descriptively with the glossary terms and dropped the duplicated «Nozzle» of the source; neither is in names.json, so the translation stands. Index 228 «Starry Surface»: first keeps the pattern name Latin («سطح Starry» / «ڕووی Starry»), I translated it; both acceptable.

Outside the sample, flagged for the integrator (not changed): row 43 «3.Spool Compatibility & Setup» fails validateTranslationRow with TOKEN_LOST because CODE_TOKEN reads the glued «3.Spool» as a code token; the translation «3. توافق البكرة والإعداد» / «3. گونجاویی ماسوورە و ڕێکخستن» is correct. The same validator false positive hits every «N.Word» heading in batches 015, 019-022 and 024 (e.g. «3.Lidar Calibration Notice», «4.Safety Tips»), so the assembler will refuse those rows and leave them English unless the source normalizer splits «N.Word» or CODE_TOKEN excludes a leading «digits.» list marker. The other 219 non-keep rows of out/023.json pass the validator with names.json and IDENTITY_TERMS.

Row 147 («HRA 90 Tougher nozzle, lower maintenance Important Notice») keeps the first translator's needs_review: the source is two bullet lines and a heading run together; the translation follows it faithfully.
